answer.origin: Finance.yahoo.com, reporting an announcement by NN, Inc.; the article was published 2026-07-01 and dates the announcement to late June 2026, but gives no exact announcement day (incoming, item:e2, item:e3).
answer.note: NN reportedly announced 47 additional machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid-cooling production for NVIDIA AI data-center racks (incoming). It said 100% of the added capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (item:e2), and targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 (item:e3). For NVDA, this is a supplier-capacity and potential supply-chain demand signal: it suggests capacity for NVIDIA-related racks has been allocated and that NN expects material new business. It does not establish that NVIDIA is the award customer, has committed to purchases, or will receive a specified amount of product. The 2026 figure is NN’s target, not reported NVIDIA revenue or orders; realization depends on execution and the awards’ terms.
limitations: The report does not identify the award customers, so it does not establish whether NVIDIA is a direct customer or how much of the pre-sold capacity serves NVIDIA-related demand.
Award values, product volumes, delivery schedule, and NN’s precise expected revenue from NVIDIA-related business are not disclosed; the 2026 new-business target is not broken out by customer.
The report provides no production-ramp or delivery results with which to verify execution of the announced capacity expansion.
The exact date of NN’s announcement is not stated; only late June 2026 is given.
follow_up: Check NN’s original late-June announcement and subsequent filings for the award counterparties, any stated NVIDIA relationship, award values, and expected deliveries.
Track NN’s subsequent disclosures for Wuxi capacity commissioning, production ramp, and realized 2026 new-business revenue, distinguishing NVIDIA-related sales from other awards.
Check NVIDIA disclosures and supplier references for confirmation of a direct NN relationship or any quantified commitment.
